minimal_new_collection.primary_minimum: One genuinely new, independently reviewed, runtime-feature-eligible negative-only canonical TRAIN group would change 19 to 20 if closure establishes no union and it introduces no positive member. minimal_new_collection.primary_recruitment: Request four new candidate roots from at least two authors not shown old wording, predictions, DEV, or desired row labels. Use non-sensitive payment-phase situations such as an account-information question, hypothetical future-payment question, a request to repeat an explanation, or a refusal without an alternative proposal. Two variants per root are a contrast-family, not new groups. These are authoring prompts, never assigned ground truth; independent annotators can reject the proposed class or mask it. minimal_new_collection.date_minimum: Four genuinely new eligible unfinished-DATE canonical TRAIN groups are required to change 16 to 20. A paired complete variant on each root does not create additional roots. At least 20 existing complete groups must remain eligible after closure; neither retention nor new group count is assumed.
minimal_new_collection.date_recruitment: Request six candidate roots from at least two new authors; include unfinished named-month constructions, ordinal complements, interrupted relative-date phrases, and scoped self-corrections across varied question/phase contexts. Preserve natural source wording. Contrast complete language with unresolved normalization (next week / that date) against unfinished syntax. Complete-but-vague must not be relabeled unfinished to meet a floor.
minimal_new_collection.candidate_pipeline: Pin raw packet, author/root/contrast ancestry, semantic definition and exact detector/window/runtime-feature versions before review. Two fresh reviewers annotate exact source spans and component role without authored labels, predictions or DEV; a separate adjudicator records disagreements without claiming blind status. Deterministically align actual candidates to independently marked spans; mask boundary/scope/privacy failures. Do not shift spans, rewrite labels or edit expected tests to match the detector.
minimal_new_collection.closure: Union author root, paraphrase carrier, template skeleton, correction contrasts, source trace lineage, exact duplicates and known ancestral aliases transitively before counting or splitting. Append signed-off closure and actual eligible counts; a new filename or new reviewer does not create an independent root. Any later union invalidates affected folds and counts.

loss_and_runtime_contract.task: One binary primary semantic head under the pinned reviewed definition; do not infer completion, polarity, consent, normalization, reference freshness or bank permission from this head.
loss_and_runtime_contract.objective: L = (1/G) sum_g [(1/m_g) sum_{i in eligible(g)} BCE(y_i,sigmoid(w dot phi(x_i)+b))] + (lambda/2)||w||^2. Exclude groups with m_g=0; intercept unpenalized in a successor implementation if explicitly frozen. Current implementation numerical convention must be reported rather than inferred from this plan.
loss_and_runtime_contract.weighting: Each canonical group has equal total weight; eligible rows inside it share that weight. No class weighting or duplication is silently added. Mixed-label groups keep their contrasting labels. Masks never become y=0.
loss_and_runtime_contract.feature_equivalence: Freeze exact source-to-feature function, dimensions, feature eligibility, numeric precision, preprocessing artifact hash and exported stdlib behavior. Native/export comparisons must cover all admitted rows including five excluded inputs; exclusion reasons and score-unavailable states must agree. No inference using privileged oracle annotations.
loss_and_runtime_contract.prediction_record: Evaluation-only record: experiment_hash, fold, canonical_group_id, example_id, source_input_hash, feature_version/hash, eligibility+reason, label_review_version, control, raw_logit, raw_score, predicted_class_at_0_5. Keep bank authority false and runtime abstention true. This adds no runtime wire heads.
loss_and_runtime_contract.footprint: Record bytes, cold load, warm latency and peak memory for the actual frozen export. Do not substitute feature-parity counts or a 4051-byte untrained contract for a trained-model footprint.

permutation_contract.exact_block_permutation: For a prospective control, permute complete training label vectors between canonical groups with identical eligible-row counts, using stable pre-label variant order and a fixed seed; do not stratify by label. Preserve whole-vector within-group dependence and the label multiset. Singleton size strata remain fixed and must be reported. Same held-out labels and folds as the main model. No row-wise independent shuffling.
permutation_contract.limited_power: Variable group sizes can leave a large unique group unmoved. Report moved roots/rows and fixed roots, not merely seed. This is a leakage/shortcut diagnostic, not a valid randomization p-value without exchangeability.
permutation_contract.supplement_if_block_permutation_weak: A separately named group-complement randomization assigns a fair fixed-seed bit per training group and XORs every label in that group. It preserves within-group contrasts and gives marginal label expectation1/2, but changes prevalence and is NOT a permutation. Report separately; never choose seeds for a desired result.

evaluation_and_selection.primary_metrics: Pool one held-out result per eligible row, then average within each canonical group and across groups: BCE, Brier score, accuracy at a predeclared0.5 threshold. Also report class-conditional group-macro recall and their mean, eligible/ambiguous/privacy exclusion counts, all-members-correct group rate, and row-micro metrics as secondary. A mixed group contributes to each applicable class metric but is still one cluster.
evaluation_and_selection.comparisons: Report paired group-level loss differences for full vs text-only, phase-only and constant, with the distribution across groups and per-fold counts. Add disagreement examples only after recording the metrics; those examples become diagnostic/exposed. A high phase-only score is not evidence of semantic learning.
evaluation_and_selection.uncertainty: Overlapping OOF training sets couple predictions. Do not treat108 rows,46 groups, or five folds as independent Bernoulli qualification trials. Group resampling of fixed OOF predictions is descriptive sensitivity, not a complete training/selection uncertainty interval. No significance or calibrated-risk claim from selecting the best control on this packet.
evaluation_and_selection.selection: OOF can choose a successor feature hypothesis. Selection among models, seeds, epochs or thresholds makes its winning score optimistic. Record every tried configuration, including abandoned runs; lock one successor before collecting further confirmation. Do not rebrand current TRAIN OOF or old exposed holdouts as independent qualification.
evaluation_and_selection.thresholds: Any score grid (for example0.5,0.7,0.8,0.9,0.95) is exploratory. Scores are not calibrated probabilities. Keep acceptance disabled while comparing them. A score threshold cannot override absent trusted raw ingress, privacy, source binding, semantic ambiguity or deterministic policy gates.

finite_sample_math.unit: On a genuinely independent future fixed-distribution sample, A_g=any accepted decision in group; E_g=any erroneous accepted semantic decision in that group. n=sum A_g, k=sum A_g*E_g. R=P(E_g=1|A_g=1) is group-level semantic risk, not per-call financial harm risk.
finite_sample_math.one_sided_CP: For0<=k<n, upper U solves sum_{j=0}^k choose(n,j) U^j(1-U)^(n-j)=alpha. For k=n, U=1; n=0 gives no risk estimate. For k=0, U=1-alpha^(1/n). Requires fixed acceptance/model and appropriate independent group sampling; not applicable to current OOF or reviewed authored TRAIN.
finite_sample_math.coverage: For N sampled independent groups and n accepted, report n/N with its own one-sided lower bound BetaInv(alpha_cov;n,N-n+1), with0 when n=0. Allocate alpha_risk+alpha_cov<=0.05 if claiming joint95% coverage of both bounds.
